description: Use this only when the person has explicitly asked to contact Pulore or send Pulore their project. Sends an external email through Resend to Pulore's fixed inbox, hello@pulore.com, so the team can reply to the person directly. This sends a message outside ChatGPT and cannot be recalled by this tool. First show them the recipient and every field you'll send, and call this only after they approve. The email contains only these fields, never the conversation. A brief identical to one sent in the last day isn't sent again, and each email address can send a few briefs a day.

budget.description: Their budget range, if they chose to share it.

company.description: Their company or role, if they gave one.

email.description: The email address Pulore should reply to.

project_brief.description: What they want to build and what they want from Pulore, exactly as they approved it. Product requirements only. Never include payment details, ID numbers, passwords, keys or health records.

timeline.description: When they hope to start or launch, if they said.

name: send_project_brief_to_pulore
title: Send a project brief to Pulore
